confidential.heading: Before we start
paragraphs: A short note so we are working from the same brief before I start bringing you people. This is the full picture I am working from: your company, your team, the roles and the bar, exactly as candidates will hear it from me. If anything here is off, or has shifted, tell me and I will recalibrate.
Everything below is my read from our conversation plus your roles pack and public research. Correct me freely. There is a box under every section, and anything you write reaches me straight away.

blocks.text: <A consequence you have drawn from the logistics, e.g. running this as a national search rather than a local one.>

Refery is not an agency. We are a private group of roughly 400 scouts globally: founders, operators, mostly C-level, and investors managing billions, who refer people they personally rate. Scouts earn a share of the fee, so nobody spends their reputation on a weak profile. You will get very few profiles from me, not a pipeline; each one is pre-screened by our team and, for roles like these, by me personally, so you sit as the final decision maker rather than the first filter.

items: **Sign the agreement.** The link is in our email thread. One signature and we are live.
**Slack and WhatsApp are our channels.** Candidates come to you there, so nothing sits in an inbox.
**Each candidate arrives ready to assess:** why they fit, their LinkedIn, and their resume. If another format works better, say the word.

**Speed wins the talent.** Great candidates at this level collect other offers fast. The hiring managers who consistently land top people share feedback almost live and get calls scheduled within days. Quick, honest feedback either way is all I ask.
**That is it.** No forms, no portal, no batching; I come back the moment I have someone interesting.
